title: The bigger picture
slide_intent: Introduce documentary photography as a way of noticing people and everyday details that a broad account of the epidemic can overlook.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can draw on its own archive to bring the people behind its work into communications.
demonstration: A full-bleed close-up shows a hand, ring, bracelet and necklace against patterned clothing. The photographic detail fills even the navigation area.
practical_value: Choose an archival image with a clear human detail that can carry the introductory page at large scale.

content_islands.name: Archive introduction
content_islands.spec: Overlay the section rail and a short white heading and introduction on the darkened left part of the photograph.

content_islands.name: Close-up photograph
content_islands.spec: Carry the image to all four edges. Give the hand over the chest most of the available area, preserving the jewelry and clothing within the crop.
